name: Church Streaming by Litenet
shortDescription: UK church livestreaming, connectivity and installation service covering single- and multi-camera setups, Wi-Fi and broadcast support.
suitableContexts: Churches needing an installed single- or multi-camera service-streaming setup
Churches that need internet connectivity or Wi-Fi addressed alongside broadcast equipment
Teams wanting supplier support for a streaming installation rather than a software-only platform

pricing.summary: The supplier directs churches to discuss their requirements. A published supplier package document describes a £2,800 plus VAT basic installation with two cameras, switching equipment and cabling; treat it as an indicative historic package and request a current written quote.

tiers.label: Indicative basic package
tiers.detail: A supplier package document describes two cameras, installation, cabling and switching equipment; confirm all current components and pricing.

gdprInformation: This is an installation and connectivity service, with services generally broadcast through external platforms such as YouTube or Facebook Live. Obtain Litenet's current privacy, support-access and network-management terms, then separately assess the privacy, retention, moderation and accessibility settings of each chosen broadcast platform.
coreFeatures: Single-camera and multi-camera church streaming options
support: Supplier describes support options for hardware and software plus fixed-rate remote engineering

uk-operator.value: Companies House records Litenet Ltd, company number 11868036, as an active UK telecommunications company. The church-streaming site identifies Litenet Ltd as its operator.

church-scope.value: Supplier describes dedicated streaming, connectivity, Wi-Fi, data-networking and VoIP offers for churches, with single- and multi-camera choices.

package-indication.value: A supplier church-streaming package document describes a £2,800 plus VAT basic installation package, with quoted pricing for additional cameras.

editorial.assessment: Church Streaming by Litenet is a UK technical-service option for a church that needs more than a streaming account: camera installation, cabling and reliable internet can be scoped together. It is not a video-hosting platform or a church-management system. A church should request an up-to-date site survey and quote, then decide separately where and how recorded services will be published and retained.
bestFor: Churches with limited in-house AV capacity
Buildings needing broadcast equipment and connectivity together
Churches evaluating a professionally installed service-streaming setup
strengths: Connectivity, Wi-Fi and cabling can be addressed alongside streaming
Published package document gives a starting point for a discussion
limitations: Installation service rather than a standalone software platform
Current costs are quote-based and any historic package price needs refresh
External broadcast-platform terms, accessibility and retention are outside the installation scope
Churches must set their own consent, safeguarding, copyright and moderation procedures

procurementVerdict.problem: Building a reliable church livestream setup where internet and AV infrastructure are constraints
procurementVerdict.differentiator: One UK supplier can scope cameras, installation, connectivity and office network infrastructure
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Request a site survey covering upload capacity, camera positions, cabling, accessibility, ownership, support hours and the destination platform for recordings
